subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should CodexBar keep this dashboard as a permanent top-level Usage & Spend Settings pane, or move the same aggregation into an existing shared overview before merge?
rationale: VISION.md requires sign-off for new product surfaces, and technical review cannot choose the long-term navigation and maintenance contract even though the branch is correct and well proven.

options.title: Keep Dedicated Pane
options.body: Approve the proven Usage & Spend destination and coordinate its aggregation helpers with the companion sharing PR if both features land.

options.title: Integrate Existing Overview
options.body: Retain the aggregation model but move presentation into an existing shared Settings overview to reduce top-level navigation surface.

options.title: Pause The Surface
options.body: Keep the branch open without merging until the dashboard and share-card product direction can be decided together.

recommendation.title: Keep Dedicated Pane
recommendation.body: Approve the proven Usage & Spend destination and coordinate its aggregation helpers with the companion sharing PR if both features land.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner has directly authored the latest branch refinements and is already the named recipient of the placement decision.
